milestones.title: Repository and data contracts
milestones.scope: Simulator-independent typed episode, provenance, validation, serialization, and remote-sync foundations.
milestones.test_results: Accepted CPU contract suite recorded in the milestone plan; no research benchmark.
known_limitations: Synthetic fixtures validate infrastructure only and carry no physical claim.

milestones.title: Deterministic action corruption
milestones.scope: Typed, seeded, action-semantic corruption proposals with immutable source continuations and complete provenance.
milestones.test_results: Deterministic CPU generation and round-trip checks recorded in the milestone plan.
known_limitations: Corruptions are unlabeled proposals; their heuristics do not establish task outcome.

milestones.title: Evidence contract and resumable evaluation runner
milestones.scope: Typed conclusive, indeterminate, invalid, and execution-error evidence with transactional publication and resume.
milestones.test_results: 538 passed and 2 skipped in the recorded M2A completion suite.
known_limitations: The deterministic evaluator is weak, synthetic evidence and is not simulator verification.

milestones.title: Generic exact-state paired replay
milestones.scope: Adapter-neutral baseline-gated paired replay with independent sessions and content-bound identities.
milestones.test_results: CPU fixture replay, exact identity, invalid-context, failure, and resume gates passed.
known_limitations: The built-in replay fixture is explicitly non-physical.

milestones.title: Real ManiSkill PickCube exact replay
milestones.scope: Compatibility-bound PickCube adapter with exact archive integrity and tolerance-verified complete runtime state restoration.
milestones.test_results: 12 valid baselines, 12 strong simulator-verified outcomes, zero execution errors, and zero-work resume.
known_limitations: Physical validation is limited to the pinned PickCube adapter and its versioned 1e-6 complete-state comparison contract.

milestones.title: State-indexed simulator evidence dataset
milestones.scope: Trajectory-grouped strong-evidence verifier dataset from baseline-gated state-indexed paired replay.
milestones.test_results: Full reload, evidence, split, leakage, integrity, and 2,880-item zero-work resume gates passed.
known_limitations: Dataset scope is one task, one robot/controller contract, and synthetic action corruptions.

milestones.title: Structured Direct Action Verifier
milestones.scope: Validation-selected structured state/action failure predictors with calibration, ranking, and coverage-risk evaluation.
milestones.test_results: Four architectures across five fixed seeds; selection froze on validation before untouched test evaluation.
known_limitations: Claims are restricted to structured PickCube state/action inputs; the temporal model was not best in the later one-shot selector benchmark.

milestones.title: Blind one-shot candidate selection
milestones.scope: Outcome-blind selection over identical candidate pools using frozen structured verifiers and untouched simulator outcomes.
milestones.test_results: 360 blind groups, 2,880 outcomes, strict manifest chronology, independent replay, bootstrap, and zero-work resume passed.
known_limitations: One-shot selection does not establish repeated receding-horizon control performance; joint MLP exceeded the selected temporal model.

milestones.title: Multi-view visual dataset
milestones.scope: State-preserving three-view rendering with content-bound packets, frozen domains, strict integrity, and external evaluation isolation.
milestones.test_results: Reload, state integrity, pixel determinism, split/leakage, external training prohibition, and zero-duplicate resume passed.
known_limitations: Images cover fixed PickCube cameras and render domains; external images are evaluation-only.

milestones.title: Visual verifier and privileged distillation
milestones.scope: Cost-aware visual verifier screening, structured-teacher distillation, and frozen external one-shot evaluation.
milestones.test_results: Validation-only promotion, three fixed seeds for promoted models, checkpoint/resume, cache equivalence, and external evaluation passed.
known_limitations: External one-shot visual selection was not statistically better than action-only; privileged distillation did not establish deployment superiority.

milestones.title: Receding-horizon visual shielding
milestones.scope: Transactional repeated candidate intervention over fresh disjoint source plans and fixed selectors/domains.
milestones.test_results: 600 episodes completed, zero execution errors, strict 600-item zero-work resume, and predeclared analysis passed; overall research targets failed.
known_limitations: Repeated learned intervention underperformed the fixed primary and privileged baselines; intervention rates were near 90 percent.

milestones.title: Conservative fallback-aware shielding
milestones.scope: Frozen validation-bound gates that accept nominal actions by default and invoke fixed fallback or alternatives conservatively.
milestones.test_results: 1,560 episodes and 24,414 decisions completed with zero task failures, unsafe outcomes, or execution errors; strict zero-work resume passed; 10 of 14 targets passed.
known_limitations: Fault override recall was 4.03 percent and gated success remained below ungated direct selection and always-fallback performance.
